h1_vector_remap.order: seeded pseudorandom order within each pair; actual order_in_pair is recorded

host_enqueue_ms.start: immediately before descriptor upload and kernel enqueue
host_enqueue_ms.stop: immediately after stop-event enqueue and before host synchronization

synchronized_kernel_ms.clock: CUDA events on the benchmark stream
excludes: host-side queue delay before start event

statistics.confidence_interval: deterministic paired percentile bootstrap of the median

gates.correctness: all valid observations pass the oracle and sanitizer gate
gates.non_regression: lower 95% CI of paired kernel improvement is at least -3% for every block count
gates.material_effect: lower 95% CI reaches at least 10% for one or more block counts
gates.trend: point-estimate improvement is non-increasing for 1, 4, 16, and 32 blocks

invalid_before_outcome_inspection: external interruption recorded by the harness
outliers.handling: retain every record with valid=false and invalid_reason; exclude the entire pair, never one arm; reruns receive a new pair_id
outliers.environmental_excursions: retain and report; thresholds may be added only by a new protocol version before observing outcomes

cuda: CPU element-wise oracle for snapshot mappings
guard regions and randomized overlap/cycle mappings

cpu_correctness_fallback.purpose: validate scheduling, block-table, refcount, COW, swap, protocol schema, and CPU reference semantics when CUDA is unavailable
